basic_info.description: This spacious and regal second-floor home perfectly blends city life with peaceful, private living on a tree-lined and gently sloped street. This condo has three true bedrooms, a full living room, and a separate formal dining room that can also be an additional family room, home office, or fourth bedroom. A private first-floor entry leads up into this wonderful full-floor flat filled with light. Large bay windows adorn the front of the building in classic San Francisco fashion. Two ornate fireplaces and an open kitchen ensure plenty of space to entertain. A private laundry room leads to a rear door and set of stairs, which span down to a sizable separate dedicated storage space, with ground level access for bicycles, as well as an enclosed tree-covered yard shared among only two other units. This excellent location enables easy access to local amenities including walkable restaurants, shopping, and parks, as well as simple commutes via public transit and freeways. Sufficient parking is typically abound and Sellers also offer the no-cost transfer of a private parking spot less than a block away.
